title: Timeline
idea: The Healo 3D x-ray reel (1.5k comments) makes the invisible visible: you watch the oil work inside her body, night by night. Swapped to skin tags (our strongest angle) with the #189 mechanism inside the x-ray and the #349-style "found it on my pillow" payoff, it should hold attention like the reference and sell the result.

script.script: This is what happens to a skin tag when she rolls castor oil on it every night.

"This is what happens to a skin tag…" → push in on the tag on her glassy neck.
"…when she rolls castor oil on it every night." → she uncaps OUR roll-on and holds it up.

script.script:
The first night, she rolls it right on the base of the skin tag on her neck and goes to sleep.
While she sleeps, the castor oil sinks deep down to the root. It's packed with ricinoleic acid, and it cuts off the skin tag's blood supply.

script.script:
By morning, it already looks a little drier.
A few nights in, it starts to darken. It's shrinking, and she can feel it getting smaller every time she rolls it on.
Then one morning, she checks her neck in the mirror… and it's gone. It fell off on its own.
It works because the castor oil is rich in ricinoleic acid, it sinks down to the root of the skin tag, where it cuts off the blood supply. The skin tag then dries up and falls off on its own.

editing_notes:
The hook is VERY important, need to nail this.
Replicate this format: Reference (link above: Healo, 86 s, 1.5k comments). Same x-ray look, same voice, same night-by-night pacing and beats, swapped to SKIN TAGS: the hook → the first night → what happens while she sleeps (x-ray: oil to the root, blood supply cut) → by morning a little drier → a few nights in it darkens and shrinks → one morning it's gone → why it works (ricinoleic acid, root, blood supply) → no cutting / freezing / $300 dermatologist → she rolls it on any new one → brand + offer.
WHAT WE CHANGED: one pain only, SKIN TAGS. No parasites, no gut. OUR method: she ROLLS it right on the base of the skin tag with the rose quartz roller.
TIME FRAMES: soft steps only ("the first night", "by morning", "a few nights in", "one morning"). No day labels or counters on screen.
THE MECHANISM (x-ray, lined up word for word): "sinks deep down to the root" = golden oil sinking through her glassy skin into the root (Johnny's #189 3D shot, about 0:15: https://hyperscale.ceo/briefs/245a7a3e-8eb5-4a80-b312-83656f40ed78); "cuts off the blood supply" = the little vessel feeding it closes (#189 about 0:16); "dries up and falls off on its own" = the tag dropping away (#189 about 0:17).
THE PAYOFF SHOT: like #349's payoff (https://hyperscale.ceo/briefs/f98d0a85-f2fc-4a0c-9f55-be8dd5e0346a): she finds the tiny dark, dried tag on her pillow and holds it up on a fingertip.
B-ROLL: 100% 3D x-ray animation of her, cut every 1.5-2 s on the reference's beats. End card: our real product (Products tab).
CAPTIONS: one or two words at a time, white bold sentence case with the key word in YELLOW, centred mid-screen (ref 0:00-1:26).
PROOF: the reference (1.5k comments); skin tags = #78, #156, #189, #316, #331, #332; the pillow find = #40.
CLARITY: one shot per line, at the reference's pacing.
CLAIMS: strongest = "it cuts off the skin tag's blood supply… it fell off on its own" (flag).
ALL PEOPLE ARE WHITE (Caucasian).
OFFER: 50% off plus a free bottle + 30-day money-back guarantee. No fake deadline. Landing page: Skin Tags.
Doc: Briefs for HS, Brief #44.

Voiceover: Faceless female narrator, American, late 30s to 40s, warm, a little conspiratorial, the reference's quick pace (one beat per line). She describes the animated woman ("she", "her"). NEEDS TO HAVE CONVICTION in their voice, its boring to listen to a dull script. They need to speak with character.

Avatar: No real person. THE LOOK (copy the reference 1:1): a 3D Pixar-style animated woman, early 40s, WHITE, long dark wavy hair, with a SEE-THROUGH X-RAY BODY: glassy skin, the skeleton visible, glowing warm gold where the castor oil works (ref 0:00-0:27). Warm, cosy home sets (bedroom, bathroom mirror), soft golden light. Swap the reference's purple HEALO packaging for OUR amber roll-on with the rose quartz ball (Products tab), everywhere. ONE small, realistic skin tag on the side of her neck (same spot every shot); in the x-ray close-ups it sits on the glassy skin with its tiny root and blood vessel visible.
